name: webfluent
description: WebFluent for VS Code: highlighting for .wf and .wfx, and the wf-lsp language server — diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition, rename and quick fixes.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace you have not trusted, its settings cannot choose the language server: `webfluent.server.path` and `webfluent.server.useWorkspaceBuild` come from your own settings only.

webfluent.server.path.markdownDescription: The `wf-lsp` to run. Empty: look on `PATH`, then download the WebFluent release this extension pins, checked against its `SHA256SUMS`. A workspace may set this only once you trust it.

webfluent.server.useWorkspaceBuild.markdownDescription: Run a `wf-lsp` built in the workspace (`target/release` or `target/debug`) — for working on the compiler itself. Read from your user settings only, and only in a trusted workspace: a folder someone else wrote could hold any program there.

webfluent.server.download.markdownDescription: Download `wf-lsp` from the WebFluent release this extension pins when it is not on `PATH`. Off: highlighting only, until a server is installed.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run build
